flavors.name: Sad Cactus
flavors.desc: Prickly pear & aloe. Brewed with tears & attitude.
flavors.ingredients: Organic Kombucha Culture, Wild Texas Prickly Pear Juice, Organic Aloe Vera Extract, Hibiscus Petals, Filtered Spring Water.
flavors.tastingNotes: Sharp, dry finish with a sweet cactus-fruit body. Light floral undertones.

flavors.name: Lone Star Blackout
flavors.ingredients: Organic Kombucha Culture, Wild Blackberries, Activated Charcoal (Coconut Source), Sweet Oak Wood Infusion, Filtered Spring Water.
flavors.tastingNotes: Rich, tannic, blackberry-forward with a smoky, earthy mouthfeel. Deep obsidian color.

flavors.name: Grapefruit Rustler
flavors.ingredients: Organic Kombucha Culture, Cold-Pressed Pink Grapefruit Juice, Fresh Garden Rosemary, Cascade Hops, Filtered Spring Water.
flavors.tastingNotes: Crisp citrus bitterness balanced by herbaceous piney-rosemary notes. Highly carbonated.
